decoDesc.text:
A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
Excavation of Precursor relics can be a rather convoluted process filled with unexpected changes. Equipment used during excavation must offer sufficient protection, dexterity, as well as offensive capabilities.

desc.text: Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.

decoDesc.text:
A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
A combat model of the Aburrey Heavy Armor. When compared to the standard model, this suit features additional weapon connection ports highly compatible with flamethrowers, grenade launchers, and other ordnance.

decoDesc.text: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all signatories shall, in addition to simultaneously guaranteeing that Talosian Credit Notes provide a currency circulation sufficient for the civil economy, guarantee a commodity stockpile sufficient for the agreed-upon supply of such types of allocation orders so as to achieve an orderly and effective joint allocation during extraordinary circumstances.

description.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>. 
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.
